text: dsh-subagents（DSH 插件，适用于挂载标准技能与系统提示词的客户端）：为 DSH 增加一组可按需调用的子代理角色和多代理协作流程。它将 13 个路由、角色及工作流技能注册到共享技能目录，并在系统提示词中加入使用指引。主要能力包括代码侦察、资料研究、实现委派、代码审查、并行审查、顾问会和审查修复循环。适合希望用自然语言委派开发、研究或复核任务的 DSH 用户。无需额外密钥或账号，需安装于支持 skills 与 systemPrompt 的 DSH profile。

dsh-subagents adds 13 child-agent persona and workflow skills to DSH. They cover code scouting, research, implementation, review, councils, and review-fix loops. The plugin registers the skills and adds system prompt guidance. It supports natural-language delegation without extra keys or accounts.
想让 DSH 把代码审查任务交给一个专门的子代理。
需要多个审查者并行检查改动的不同方面。
让 DSH 先侦察陌生代码库，再帮我规划修改。
我想把实现工作委派给一个遵循已批准方案的代理。
I want a second opinion from a child agent before making a decision.
Can DSH run research and code scouting in parallel, then combine the findings?
dsh-subagents 的功能「角色委派」：提供侦察、研究、实现、审查等角色技能，按用户需求加载匹配技能并委派任务。
dsh-subagents 的功能「并行审查」：启动多个审查者从不同角度检查改动，并汇总有依据的发现。
dsh-subagents 的功能「审查修复循环」：编排实现、审查和修复，默认最多三轮，并按条件停止。
dsh-subagents 的功能「顾问会与并行研究」：安排顾问讨论决策，或并行收集本地与外部证据并综合结果。
想让几个代理先各自研究，再给我一个有来源的综合结论。
DSH 能不能帮我把大任务拆给不同角色，并行推进？

dsh-subagents README · dsh-subagents：**Focused child-agent delegation and multi-agent workflows for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).**

> A faithful port of [`pi-subagents`](https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-subagents), rebuilt on DSH's **native** `subagent` / `subagent_fork` / `workflow` tools — so you get the curated personas and workflows without giving up DSH's built-in delegation.

- 🇨🇳 [中文文档](README.zh.md)

dsh-subagents README · Why this exists：DSH already ships delegation (`subagent`, `subagent_fork`, `workflow`, `agent_teams`) and an on-demand skill system. What it does **not** ship is a ready-made set of *who* to delegate to and *how* to chain them.

`dsh-subagents` fills that gap with:

dsh-subagents README · Why this exists：| Need | You get |
| --- | --- |
| A second pair of eyes before you edit | `reviewer` persona with P0/P1/P2 findings + a merge verdict |
| A sanity check on a risky decision | `oracle` persona that challenges assumptions without editing |
| Fast recon of unfamiliar code | `scout` persona for entry points, data flow, and risks |
| Grounded external facts | `researcher` persona producing a sourced brief |
| A careful implementer | `worker` persona that edits minimally and escalates instead of guessing |
| Orchestrated review/impl loops | `parallel-review`, `review-loop`, `council`, `parallel-research`, `parallel-cleanup`, `gather-context` workflows |

dsh-subagents README · Why this exists：**Problems solved:** no hand-rolled prompts, no remembering role tool-allowlists, no reinventing review loops. One install and you can say *"use reviewer to review this diff"* and get a disciplined review.

**What makes it different:** it's not a new agent runtime — it's a thin, dependency-light skill layer (pure ESM, zero runtime deps) that teaches the model how to use DSH's own tools, so it composes with everything else in your profile (AgentTeams, MCP servers, skills, themes).

dsh-subagents README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-subagents

dsh-subagents README · or from a local checkout:：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-subagents
```

Restart the dsh process, and you're done — no config, no slash commands.

dsh-subagents README · Try this first：- "Use reviewer to review this diff."
- "Ask oracle for a second opinion on my current plan."
- "Use scout to understand this code."
- "Run parallel reviewers: one for correctness, one for tests, one for simplicity."

The model loads the matching `subagents-*` skill and delegates with the native tools. You don't create agents, write config, or learn commands.

dsh-subagents README · Builtin roles：| Role | Use when you want… |
| --- | --- |
| `scout` | Fast local codebase recon: relevant files, entry points, data flow, risks. |
| `researcher` | Web/docs research with sources and a concise brief. |
| `worker` | Implementation: edits files, validates, escalates unapproved decisions. |
| `reviewer` | Code/plan review with P0/P1/P2 findings and a merge verdict. |
| `oracle` | A second opinion before acting; challenges assumptions without editing. |
| `delegate` | A lightweight general handoff close to the parent session. |

dsh-subagents README · Workflows：| Want | Skill |
| --- | --- |
| Debate a material decision | `subagents-council` — bounded parent-mediated advisor council |
| Review a diff adversarially | `subagents-parallel-review` — several fresh reviewers, distinct angles |
| Implement → review → fix until clean | `subagents-review-loop` — capped at 3 rounds |
| Build a grounded multi-angle answer | `subagents-parallel-research` — researcher + scout |
| Clean up AI-slop / verbosity | `subagents-parallel-cleanup` — deslop + verbosity passes |
| Gather context, then clarify | `subagents-gather-context` — scout/researcher, then clarifying questions |

dsh-subagents README · How it maps to DSH：| pi-subagents | dsh-subagents / DSH |
| --- | --- |
| `subagent` tool | `subagent` (fresh) / `subagent_fork` (context-aware) |
| `workflowScript` | `workflow` |
| multi-agent teams | `agent_teams` (native) |
| builtin agents (`.md` frontmatter) | skills `subagents-scout`, `subagents-reviewer`, … |
| prompt shortcuts | skills `subagents-council`, `subagents-parallel-review`, … |
| `context: fresh` / `fork` | `subagent` / `subagent_fork` |
| async / background | `run_in_background: true` + `job_output` / `job_kill` |
| `subagent({action:"list"})` | `list_agents` (children) + the skills catalog |

dsh-subagents README · How it maps to DSH：> **Note on roles:** DSH's `subagent` tool fixes persona/tool-filter at config level, not per call. So role switching here is prompt-driven: each role is a skill whose persona text you paste into the child's `prompt`. Hard per-role tool isolation would require a DSH agent-preset composition layer — see [Limitations](#limitations).

dsh-subagents README · Layout：```
lib/index.js        host plugin — registers skills + a usage section
skills/*.md         the persona and workflow bodies
cordis.patch.yml    mounts the plugin into a profile's host composition
```

dsh-subagents README · Requirements：- Node ≥ 20 (ESM).
- A DSH profile whose base bundle mounts `skills` and `systemPrompt` (standard profiles do).

dsh-subagents README · Limitations：- Role personas are **soft** guidance: a child inherits DSH's toolset and self-limits by the persona's tool guidance. There is no per-call tool-allowlist enforcement.
- `council` cross-exams use a fresh re-launch rather than resuming the same child, because DSH one-shot subagents are not resumable (use `subagent_fork` + `send_message` for a resumable child when you need it).

dsh-subagents README · Contributing：Bug reports and PRs are welcome. Please open an [issue](https://github.com/geekyfoxlab/dsh-subagents/issues) before starting non-trivial work. There is no build step — the plugin is plain ESM, so `node --check lib/index.js` and a mock `apply()` run are the smoke tests.
